title: Test USB flash backend flash_sign/verify/decrypt crypto ops
description: src/wp11_backend_usb_flash.c implements flash_sign, flash_verify, and flash_decrypt using wolfCrypt directly (same structure as the FSDIR backend we just tested in wolfP11-kwzw). No test file exists for these operations. Need to add test/wp11_test_backend_usb_flash.c with independent-oracle tests analogous to the FSDIR tests: sign-then-oracle-verify, external-sign-then-verify (positive + negative), ECDSA_SHA256 sign, RSA sign, RSA decrypt. The flash backend reads keys from wp11_keystore_t entries just like FSDIR.
